verdict.rationale: Tavily's public pricing page lists a self-serve pay-as-you-go rate of $0.008 per credit ('Pay only for what you use') plus 1,000 free credits per month with no credit card required, so a developer can see per-credit pricing without contacting sales. Per-request usage logs and a usage endpoint let developers track spend. A community user also describes Tavily as a paid per-search API. Missing for 10: documentation of how many credits each request type costs (search, extract, crawl, research), and an explicit statement that higher tiers need no sales contact.
